issue_context.title: Change format for specific loads and still get transition drawable
issue_context.body: Is it possible to change the load format between ARGB and RGB_565 for specific loads and still load a drawable to get the transition effect between thumbnail and actual image?

review_comments: @TWiStErRob any chance you know about a more recent solution for crossfades with PaletteBitmap targets? I had originally tried GenericTransitionOptions with a basic fade animation, but it doesn't work with placeholders, which are removed before the animation starts. This solution looked promising (had to make adjustments since it's four years old) but the animation is completely ignored with the above method, even with a custom duration.

I think that may be due to the fact that your placeholder and final image are not the same type, so there is no transition between them. I haven't used Glide 4 enough to know more details, it could be a simple behavior change between 3 and 4. Try to look around the factories and targets to see who is removing the placeholder and try to work backwards from there to find how it could be avoided. You could also try to follow your animation object to see where it gets ignored.

Thank you so much! It ended up being a stray line of code in `onResourceReady()` for a custom target. I'm now encountering another issue though, and would appreciate any insight if possible. When the images are leave the frame in a RecyclerView and then enter again while scrolling, the placeholder shows up indefinitely. My first theory was that the TransitionDrawable was somehow reset and the initial layer was shown with no animation start. I also thought it might be an issue with the BitmapPool or recycled images. Does either of those sound more plausible based on the symptoms?

Nice. Btw, `null` answer is easy:
https://github.com/bumptech/glide/blob/a3a3a6573addd83a5be031bbd55d29e7514ca446/library/src/main/java/com/bumptech/glide/request/target/ImageViewTarget.java#L56-L96
I've updated the code above.
